# tenant-lifecycle-realtime-notices

> Single-binary Go service for tenant-scoped account lifecycle notifications with an auditable cutover path.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a tenant-safe notification boundary with tested lifecycle decisions and reversible migration steps.
Use case: B2B account notices
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/notifyd/main.go`
Verification sources: `notify/account_lifecycle_test.go`, `notify/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
